items.title: Wilbur DeParis Interview, 1959-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Paul Balburn had mentioned them to me I wondered if it was the same fellows [INTERVIEWEE] it probably was

ctx.x: I forget their first names there was brother there were brothers Wolfscale brothers and I think Roy was the name of one of them
Paul Balburn had mentioned them to me I wondered if it was the same fellows
